message.content:
This vertical, rectangular editorial illustration mimics a magazine cover. A bold red vertical band runs along the left edge. The background is a flat, light gray. Overlapping the top center is the large, black, sans-serif word "TEMPO".

The central composition features illustrated portraits of four men and two large, white, silhouette-shaped cutouts. The men are rendered in a realistic, painterly style. On the left, a man in a white button-up shirt and glasses smiles towards the viewer. Behind him, another man with glasses and a dark shirt leans to the left. Further back, a man with glasses and a dark blue polo shirt smiles broadly. To the right, a man with a mustache wears a dark, patterned button-up shirt.

Two large, featureless white silhouettes occupy the foreground and right side. One silhouette is in the lower center, and the other is a larger figure on the right, partially obscuring the man with the mustache and the letter "O" in "TEMPO".

Bold red text in the lower center reads: "AGUS HILANG, SIAPA TERBILANG". Below this, smaller black text states: "ANIES DAN AHOK BEREBUT SUARA PEMILIH AGUS YUDHOYONO. ADU GESIT MELOBI PARTAI PENDUKUNG." Additional text at the top includes: "KSAU TENTANG HELI BERMASALAH" and "BABAK BARU KONTRAK FREEPORT". The bottom right contains a date "20-26 FEBRUARI 2017", price "RP 45.000", a website, and a barcode.
